# createEcho — POST /echoes

Echo a message back

## Verified behaviors

- **The message comes back verbatim, stamped with server time** — The posted message is echoed back exactly, alongside `dateSent`, the server's own clock. Every request field is optional — an empty body is a valid connectivity check and comes back with `message: null`. ([replay](../behaviors/echo-round-trips-the-message.md))

## Behavior

Test endpoint: echoes the posted message back with a server timestamp. Safe to call freely; useful for verifying auth and connectivity. Accepts an empty body (all fields nullable).

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X POST \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/echoes' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "message": "hello"
}'
```

## Request body (required)

A message to send to the echo endpoint. Every field is optional.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string or null | Text to echo back verbatim. |
| `delayInMilliseconds` | integer or null | Optional server-side delay before responding, in milliseconds. Warning: -1 hangs the connection indefinitely; other negative values return 500. |

`*` = required.

### `200` body — Echo

The posted message, echoed back with a server timestamp.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` * | string or null | The message exactly as posted. |
| `dateSent` * | string (date-time) | Server time when the response was produced. |
| `delayInMilliseconds` | integer or null | The delay that was applied, echoed back. |

`*` = required.
